  WHY: Those imports now raise `ImportError`, breaking lessons-learned persistence and related schema validation paths.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:25-113 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The Phase C persona-prefix system (`PHASE_C_PERSONA_PREFIXES` / `apply_phase_c_persona_prefix`) was removed.
  WHY: Legacy-mode prompt renders lose their phase-specific persona framing, changing prompt content and model behavior.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:870-906 | severity=critical | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: The call to `apply_phase_c_persona_prefix` was removed from the render path.
  WHY: Even if the persona-prefix definitions existed, rendered prompts would still lose the prefixing step that previously applied to legacy-mode renders.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:239-270 | severity=high | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: The script creates a temp file and registers an EXIT cleanup trap, but `exec "${RENDER_ARGS[@]}"` replaces the shell before the trap can run.
  WHY: The assembled prompt temp file is leaked on every render when the refactor flag is enabled.
- scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh:279 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The judge template staging loop omits migrated templates that other bootstrap paths still stage.
  WHY: Missing `_templates/mode-judge.txt`, `_templates/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt`, and `_templates/mode-orchestrate-poll-judge.txt` can make support-bundle renders fail with missing files.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:168-191 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Include-path resolution can fall through without a containment guard when `prompt_root` is `None`.
  WHY: The resolved include only has to be a file, not necessarily remain within the prompts tree.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:217-244 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_sync_memory_reference_files` was rewritten from a two-pass backfill to a single-source approach.
  WHY: Partial vendored schema sets can now stay incomplete, causing later schema validation to fail on missing files.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:59-64,103-108 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Canonical definitions for `ai:retro`, `ai:security-audit`, and `ai:security` were removed from the label catalogs.
  WHY: Fresh label creation falls back to default GitHub metadata, drifting from the established label contract.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:418-483 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `ai:scope` post-commit verifier block was deleted.
  WHY: Out-of-scope commits are no longer blocked or rolled back before push/PR creation.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:168-191 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `evaluate` docstring still describes the old allowlist-oriented behavior after the CLI/helper refactor.
  WHY: This is documentation drift, not a runtime failure, but it misrepresents the current API.
- agents.md:62-73 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The materiality/contract documentation was not updated to reflect production behavior changes elsewhere in the diff.
  WHY: Review tooling relies on `agents.md` to describe operator-visible contracts; stale docs hide contract drift.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py
  Line or code reference: 146-152
  Problem: Replacing the custom `_path_glob_matches` function (which handled `*` as non-directory-crossing and `**` as globstar) with `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` changes the allowlist matching semantics.
  Why it fails at runtime: Python's `fnmatch` treats `*` as matching any characters including `/`, so a pattern like `tests/*.py` now matches `tests/integration/test_foo.py`, and `**` is treated literally as two `*` characters rather than as a globstar.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/ai_memory_lib.py
  Line or code reference: Entire file — function `record_lessons_learned` and all supporting code removed
  Problem: The function `record_lessons_learned` has been deleted from `ai_memory_lib.py`, but three production scripts still import and call it.
  Why it fails at runtime: When any of these scripts execute, the Python import of `record_lessons_learned` from `ai_memory_lib` will raise `ImportError`, causing the lessons-learned memory persistence path to fail.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/render_prompt.py
  Line or code reference: 870-906 (main function), formerly there was a call to `apply_phase_c_persona_prefix` between assembly and rendering
  Problem: The `apply_phase_c_persona_prefix` function and the `PHASE_C_PERSONA_PREFIXES` dictionary have been removed.
  Why it fails at runtime: Every prompt rendered through `render_prompt.sh` will produce different output than before because the phase-specific persona framing is gone.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/render_prompt.sh
  Line or code reference: 239 (trap registration) and 270 (exec)
  Problem: When `PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED=true`, the script creates a temp file and registers a cleanup trap, but ends with `exec "${RENDER_ARGS[@]}"`, so the EXIT trap never fires.
  Why it fails at runtime: Temp files accumulate in the prompts directory and are leaked on every render.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh
  Line or code reference: 279 (the prompt_assembly_asset loop)
  Problem: The judge template staging loop only includes `_prelude_common.txt`, `_prelude_semble.txt`, `_prelude_output_contract.txt`, `_templates/mode-judge-interim.txt`, and `_templates/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt`.
  Why it fails at runtime: If any unstaged judge template is rendered, the assembly path will fail because the template file is missing from `${SUPPORT_PROMPTS_DIR}/_templates/`.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/render_prompt.py
  Line or code reference: 168-191 (`_resolve_include_path` function)
  Problem: When `prompt_root` is `None`, include-path resolution falls through without a containment guard.
  Why it fails at runtime: The resolved path is only required to be a file — it is not validated to reside within the `prompts/` tree.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
